name: Batuv
description: Batuv was a planet in the Expansion Region that was occupied and blockaded by the Galactic Empire. Prior to his meeting with Tobias Beckett, Captain Lando Calrissian, and his co-pilot L3-37 took the Millennium Falcon to Batuv where Calrissian picked up a cape from Borkus.
lead_paragraphs: Batuv was a planet in the Expansion Region that was occupied and blockaded by the Galactic Empire. Prior to his meeting with Tobias Beckett, Captain Lando Calrissian, and his co-pilot L3-37 took the Millennium Falcon to Batuv where Calrissian picked up a cape from Borkus.
